title: They aren't really pilling up, more like linting up. Very strange.
text: They aren't really pilling up, more like linting up. Very strange.. Not sure what the deal is with these. They're not supposed to pill or anything, but these produce amazing lint. I kind of don't get it--it's really odd. They're like new towels or something, with lint coming off them all the time. I've never seen pillow cases do this before. Very disappointed.
